defer:
recursive fn make()->i64[2]{var a:i64[2]=[3,4];defer{a[1]=9;}return a;}
fn main(){var a:i64[2]=make();assert(a[1]==4);print("defer");}
refs:
recursive fn make(p:i64&)->i64&[2]{return[p,p];}
fn main(){var data:i64[]=[7];var a:i64&[2]=make(data[0]);a[1]++;assert(data[0]==8);assert(a[0]==8);print("refs");}
recursion:
recursive fn make(n:i64)->i64[2]{if n==0{return[1,2];}var a:i64[2]=make(n-1);return[a[0]+n,a[1]+n];}
fn main(){var a:i64[2]=make(9);assert(a[0]==46);assert(a[1]==47);print("recursion");}
growth:
recursive fn make()->u8[70000]{var a:u8[70000]=default<u8[70000]>();a[69999]=11;return a;}
fn main(){var a:u8[70000]=make();assert(a[0]==0);assert(a[69999]==11);print("growth");}
conditional:
recursive fn make(n:i64)->i64[2]{return if n>0{[n,n+1]}else{[0,1]};}
fn main(){var a:i64[2]=make(7);var b:i64[2]=make(0);assert(a[1]==8);assert(b[1]==1);print("conditional");}
block:
recursive fn make(n:i64)->i64[2]{return{let m=n+1;[m,m+1]};}
fn main(){var a:i64[2]=make(7);assert(a[1]==9);print("block");}
